source_text: These organizations cite no empirical evidence of benefits, positioning FGM as a form of gender-based violence incompatible with conventions like the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child (ratified by 196 states as of 2023), which mandates safeguarding children from traditional practices prejudicial to their health.
